title: The Midnight Poisoning
description: A wealthy heir was found dead at Blackwood Manor after a private dinner. The apparent timeline leaves ten questions for the detective to break the suspect's story.

truth.sequence: Ethan argued with Daniel, poisoned his whiskey, then left the manor.

alibi.claim: I was at home watching a football match from 21:45 onward.

evidence.name: Gate Camera
evidence.description: A camera records Ethan's car entering the manor road at 22:18.

evidence.name: Phone Location
evidence.description: Ethan's phone connected to a cell sector covering the manor between 22:21 and 22:47.

evidence.name: Poison Bottle
evidence.description: Ethan's fingerprint is on the inner cap of the poison bottle recovered from the study.

evidence.name: Motive
evidence.description: Daniel had changed his will, reducing Ethan's inheritance dramatically.

opening_statement: I did not kill Daniel. We argued earlier, but I left him alive and went home.
